column1: W1g. tinySA level calibration and floor

# The terminated floor is this instrument's own noise floor: 50 ohm on the input, LNA and pad as you intend to use them. Any ambient reading within a few dB of it is a measurement of the analyzer, not the site.
# Run the self-test and the low-input level calibration before trusting a reading, and again after a firmware update.
